source: Chapter 669: Connivance
target: Capitulum 669: Connivantia

source: Translator: CKtalon
target: Interpretator: CKtalon

source: Recalling Franca’s meeting with 007 tonight to discuss dealing with Moran Avigny, Lumian decided to summon Jenna’s messenger, Rabbit Chasel, as he had to return to Trier tomorrow to discuss the division of labor and specific details.
target: Meminens conventum Francae cum 007 hac nocte ad negotiandum de Moran Avigny, Lumian decrevit evocare nuntium Iennae, Lepum Chasel, cum cras ad Trier redire oporteret ut de divisione laboris et rebus specificis dissereret.

source: After jotting down Madam Magician’s request and folding it, Lumian set up a ritual, allowing the special Rabbit of Knowledge to emerge from the candle’s flames.
target: Postquam petitionem Dominae Magicae conscripsit et involvit, Lumian caerimoniam instituit, ut peculiaris Lepus Cognitionis ex flammis candelae emergeret.

source: The first thing Lumian noticed was the miniature half top hat snugly perched between the rabbit’s ears.
target: Prima re quam Lumian animadvertit fuit parvus pileus, quasi “top hat” in forma dimidiata, commodē insidens inter auricula leporis.

source: Next, he saw gold-rimmed glasses and a black trench coat that matched the vaguely rabbit-shaped creature’s size.
target: Deinde vidit oculos vitricos margine aureo ornatos et vestem nigrum in stylo trench, quae ad magnitudinem creaturae, quae vago leporum similis videbatur, convenienter coincidebat.

source: Finally, an iron-black revolver lay in the rabbit’s palm.
target: Denique, revolver ex ferro nigro in palma leporis iacebat.

source: The revolver gleamed with a metallic luster, its barrel unusually thick, and its cylinder unnaturally large and textured.
target: Revolver nitore metallico fulgebat; canna eius insolite crassa erat, et cylindrus eius mirum in modum magnus atque texturatus videbatur.

source: It stood in stark contrast to the illusory appearance of the top hat, trench coat, and gold-rimmed glasses.
target: Revolver in flagrantī discrimine stabat comparatus spei fallacis pilei, vestis trench, ac oculorum vitricorum margine aureo ornatorum.

source: Upon seeing Rabbit Chasel, Lumian raised his eyebrows.
target: Cum Lepum Chasel vidit, Lumian supercilia eleganter elevavit.

source: “Is this a real gun?”
target: “Num hoc vere sclopetum est?”

source: “Yes.”
target: “Ita.”

source: “Did Jenna customize it for you?” Lumian inquired.
target: “Num Jenna id tibi ordinavit?” Lumian quaesivit.

source: Rabbit Chasel replied succinctly, “It’s payment.”
target: Lepus Chasel breviter respondit: “Est solutio.”

source: Quite a cold demeanor… Miss Celia Bello, have you considered the consequences of what you’ve done? You haven’t! Because I don’t know the consequences either unless I consult Madam Magician… Lumian criticized inwardly before handing the folded letter to Rabbit Chasel.
target: Habitus tuus frigidus valde est… Domina Celia Bello, num consequentias factorum tuorum consideravisti? Immo, non fecisti! Quia neque ego consequentias novi, nisi Magistram Magicam consulerim, Lumian interius reprehendit, antequam epistolam involutam Lepori Chasel tradidit.

source: Seeing the human-like, rabbit-shaped creature preparing to turn and walk into the candle flame, Lumian, the Prankster King of Cordu, asked with interest, “Can you shoot?”
target: Animadvertere creaturam, quae humano similis et leporum figura praeparabat ut converteret atque in flammam candelae ambulareret, Lumian, Rex Lusor Cordi, cum studio interrogavit: “Potesne iaculari?”

source: Rabbit Chasel fell silent for a moment, as if embarrassed.
target: Lepus Chasel paulisper tacuit, quasi vereberetur.

source: “Not yet.”
target: “Non adhuc.”

source: Oh, you’re not as cold as Gehrman Sparrow anymore… Lumian chuckled and said, “Jenna and I are friends. I’ll help her pay the postage fee this time.”
target: “O, non iam es tam frigidus quam Gehrman Sparrow… ” Lumian cachinnavit et dixit: “Jenna et ego amici sumus; hac vice illi vectigal epistularum solvendum adiuvabo.”

source: “Do you want to learn shooting? It involves knowledge and guidance.”
target: “Visne discere iaculari? Id implicat scientiam et consilium.”

source: Rabbit Chasel, taller than an ordinary rabbit, replied without hesitation, “Sure thing.”
target: Lepus Chasel, altior quam lepus vulgaris, respondit sine mora: “Certe!”

source: Lumian’s smile broadened.
target: Risus Lumiani latius factus est.

source: After finding a secluded spot at the edge of the primitive forest and earnestly teaching Rabbit Chasel how to shoot for a considerable time, Lumian strolled back to Tizamo with his hands in his pockets, planning to visit the only cafe for afternoon tea.
target: Postquam locum secretum in margine silvae rudis invenit et Lepum Chasel diu artem iaculandi diligenter docuit, Lumian cum manibus in sinibus ad Tizamo rediit, consiliis habens solam cauponam ad theam meridianam visitandam.

source: The cafe bore the name “Bunia” after its owner, a man named Bunia.
target: Cafeteria nomen “Bunia” habebat ex proprietario, viro nominato Bunia.

source: He was under the age of 30.
target: Habebat aetatem infra triginta annos.

source: Having once served as a waiter and apprentice at a cafe in Port Pylos, Bunia, recalling the lack of a proper cafe in Tizamo Town, transformed the ground floor of his house into a semi-open cafe.
target: Olim tamquam ministrum et discipulum in caupona Porti Pylos laboravit; Bunia, meminens defectum cauponae idoneae in oppido Tizamo, imum domus suae in semi-apertam cauponam convertit.

source: Lumian, weaving through the tables and chairs on the street, arrived at the kitchen counter, offering a smile to the proprietor and waiter, Bunia.
target: Lumian, inter mensas et sellas in via ambulans, ad mensam coquinae pervenit, proprietati atque ministri, Bunia, risum offerens.

source: “Do you have Fermo coffee?”
target: “Habesne Fermo caffeum?”

source: Bunia’s brown skin, not too dark, and his features resembling those of mixed blood, showcased his Tizamon heritage.
target: Cutis brunnea Buniae, non nimis obscura, et vultus eius, qui sanguinis mixti similitudinem habebat, ostenderunt patrimonium Tizamon.

source: The man in his late twenties responded with an honest smile in fluent Intisian.
target: Vir, cui proxime viginti annos complebantur, respondit risu sincero in lingua Intisiana fluente.

source: “Monsieur, there’s no Fermo coffee.”
target: “Domine, Fermo caffeum non invenitur.”

source: Lumian, intending to playfully inquire, casually switched to a cup of Corsa coffee from Matani.
target: Lumian, intendens facetari, leviter ad poculum Corsa caffeae ex Matani transiit.

source: Sipping the bitter and sweet liquid at a table, he noticed Camus, adorned in a vest, and Rhea, clad in leather armor, entering the cafe.
target: Hauriens liquidum amarum et dulcem ad mensam, animadvertit Camum, ornamentaliter indutum in veste, et Rheam, lorica ex corio induta, cauponam ingredientes.

source: Each ordered an Intis coffee and a corn nutcake imbued with Tizamo flair.
target: Singuli imperaverunt caffeum Intisianum et placenta ex grano, Tizamo ingenio infusam.

source: Upon spotting Rhea, the single Bunia became even more bashful and busier, avoiding eye contact.
target: Rhea conspecta, Bunia solitarius magis verecundus atque occupatus factus est, oculos avertens.

source: As Camus and Rhea, equipped with their coffee and corn nutcakes, sought a spot, Lumian raised his arm in greeting.
target: Cum Camus ac Rhea, cum caffeo et placentis instructi, locum quaerebant, Lumian brachium suum ad salutandum elevavit.

source: As Camus and Rhea reluctantly settled into their seats across from him, Lumian inquired with a smile, “Why do you look so tired?”
target: Dum Camus ac Rhea vix consentientes in sellas prae se consederunt, Lumian risu quaesivit: “Cur tam fessi videmini?”

source: Glancing at the energetic adventurer, Camus took a deep breath and slowly exhaled.
target: Aspiciens ad adventatorem animosum, Camus spiritum altum cepit et lente exhalavit.

source: “We just finished work. We can finally rest.”
target: “Modo opus finivimus. Nunc demum quiescere possumus.”

source: Yesterday, he had monitored the Brieu Motel late into the night!
target: Heri, Brieu Motel usque ad nocturnam horam observaverat!

source: “All I want now is a good night’s sleep.”
target: “Nunc tantum volo bonum nocturnum somnum.”

source: After exploring the dream together last night, Rhea wasn’t as reticent as before when facing Lumian.
target: Postquam heri nocte somnium simul exploraverunt, Rhea non iam tam tacita erat coram Lumiano.

source: “Then why are you still drinking coffee?” Lumian replied with amusement.
target: “Ergo, cur adhuc caffeum potas?” Lumian, ridens, respondit.

source: It was evident that Rhea and Camus lacked the energy of a Sleepless.
target: Manifestum erat Rhea et Camus vim insomnium deficere.

source: “I want to endure until dinner before sleeping,” Camus said with a sigh.
target: “Volo usque ad cenam sustinere antequam dormiam,” Camus suspirans dixit.

source: Rhea shook her head.
target: Rhea caput movit.

source: “Coffee is useless to me.”
target: “Caffeum mihi inutilis est.”

source: After a brief chat, Rhea finished her corn nutcake and coffee, then headed back to the nearby police headquarters to rest.
target: Post brevem colloquium, Rhea crustulum ex grano et caffeum confecit, deinde ad praetorium vicinum rediit ut se quiesceret.

source: Camus continued to recline in the armchair, occasionally taking a sip of coffee.
target: Camus in lecto bracchiali recumbens manebat, interdum poculum caffeae sorbens.

source: “Has Reaza arrived?” Lumian inquired with a smile.
target: “Num Reaza advenit?” Lumian risu quaesivit.

source: Camus fell silent for a moment.
target: Camus paulisper tacuit.

source: “He’s here. Tonight, one of the two—Maslow and Loban—will be following you with him.”
target: “Hic adest. Hac nocte, unus ex duobus—Maslow et Loban—tecum ipse sequetur.”

source: As for Kolobo, there was no need for him to be on duty. If he didn’t even dare to look, how could he do any monitoring?
target: Quoad Kolobo, non opus erat eum in officio esse. Si ne spectare quidem ausus est, quomodo vigilare posset?

source: While they conversed, Lumian noticed Miss Amandina from Palm Manor leading a short unicorn outside the Bunia cafe, exuding high spirits.
target: Dum colloquebantur, Lumian animadvertit Dominam Amandinam ex Palmis Manerio brevem unicornem extra cauponam Bunia ducere, lumine animi laeto effundente.

source: The blue-eyed girl was clad in off-white hunting attire today, her black hair fashioned into a half‑height bun.
target: Puella oculis caeruleis, hodie induta erat vestimenta venatoria pallida, et capillos nigros in parvo nodo collectos habebat.

source: After entrusting the whip and reins to the brown‑skinned valet, she strolled to the kitchen counter with her lady’s maid, who also bore an Intisian appearance.
target: Postquam flagellum et retia servi cutis brunnea tradidit, illa cum ancilla sua, quae quoque indolem Intisianam gerebat, ad mensam coquinae ambulavit.

source: Along the way, she cheerfully greeted the patrons in the cafe and exchanged pleasantries with the locals sipping on inexpensive coffee.
target: Per viam laete clientes in caupona salutavit et cum indigenis, qui caffeum vilis sorbebant, amoena verba commutavit.

source: Observing Camus’s gaze fixed on the girl, Lumian teased, “Do you wish to engage in a duel with her fiance?”
target: Animadvertus oculos Camus in puellam directos, Lumian illam provocavit: “Visne certamen habere cum sponsulo tuo?”

source: “No, I’m not that kind of person,” Camus replied with a serious expression.
target: “Non, non sum talis persona,” Camus serio respondit.

source: “I admit that she’s indeed very attractive to me, but she’s already engaged to Monsieur Robert. This is a sign that she’s starting a family. I can’t allow myself to destroy someone else’s family.”
target: “Agno eam mihi vere amabilem esse, sed iam sponsa Domini Roberti est. Hoc signum est eam familiam condere incipere; non possum meipsum sinere alicuius familiae nocere.”

source: “You Feynapotterians…” Lumian didn’t mock him but sighed with emotion.
target: “Vos Feynapotteriani…” Lumian eum non irridit sed affectu suspiravit.

source: Such values appealed to Feynapotter.
target: Talia virtutes Feynapotteri complacuerunt.

source: Of course, not every Feynapotterian possessed such values.
target: Certe, non omnes Feynapotteriani talia valores possidebant.

source: Seeing Lumian’s lack of response, Camus said seriously, "Don’t have any ideas about her."
target: Videns quiescentiam Lumiani, Camus serio dixit: "Nihil de ea cogita."

source: Lumian regarded the young man surnamed Castiya with amusement, awaiting further “explanation.”
target: Lumian iuvenculum, cognomento Castiya, ridens contemplatus est, ulteriores explicationes exspectans.

source: Camus furrowed his brow slightly.
target: Camus leviter supercilia contraxit.

source: “I know you Intisians won’t back down just because the other party has a fiance or a husband. You might find it even more exciting, but you always pursue momentary pleasure. Very few are willing to take responsibility. You always satisfy yourself. When you’re happy, you turn around and leave, leaving a lady to face everything that’s been destroyed.”
target: "Scio vos Intisianos non recedere solum quia altera pars sponsum aut maritum habet; forsitan hoc vobis magis excitandi videatur, sed semper voluptatem momentaneam persequimini. Valde pauci sunt qui responsabilitatem suscipere volunt, et vos ipsi semper vobis satisfacitis: cum laeti estis, vertimini et disceditis, relinquentes feminam quae omnia deleta subire debeat."

source: “Not every Intisian is like this,” Lumian shook his head with a smile.
target: “Non omnes Intisiani sunt tales,” Lumian caput movens, risu dixit.

source: But most Trieriens are like that… However, neither party is innocent in such matters… he added inwardly.
target: Sed plerique Trierenses ita sunt… et tamen neutra pars in talibus rebus innocens est, inquit interius.

source: The energetic and playful Amandina led the lady’s maid past Camus and Lumian’s table.
target: Amandina, animosa et ludicra, ancillam praeter mensam Camus et Lumiani duxit.

source: First, she greeted Camus, then sized up Lumian and said candidly, “I'm Amandina. What about you?”
target: Primum Camum salutavit, deinde Lumian observavit et aperte dixit: “Ego sum Amandina. Quid de te?”

source: “Louis Berry,” Lumian replied with a smile.
target: “Louis Berry,” Lumian risu respondit.

source: Amandina nodded and suddenly laughed.
target: Amandina caput inclinavit et subito risit.

source: “You must have just arrived from Trier. You’re different from the people here.”
target: “Certe recens ex Trier advenisti; tu aliter te geris quam homines hic.”

source: “No, I’m from a village in the south,” Lumian switched to Intisian with a Dariege accent.
target: “Non, ex vico meridionali sum,” Lumian in lingua Intisiana cum accentu Dariege mutavit.

source: Amandina wasn’t disappointed. She happily inquired about the folklore of the southern provinces of the Intis Republic before leading the lady’s maid to a table in the corner.
target: Amandina non fuit contrita; laeta de fabulis provinciarum meridionalium Reipublicae Intis interrogavit, antequam ancillam ad mensam anguli duxit.

source: Camus watched as the two of them conversed. He opened his mouth but closed it again.
target: Camus eos duos colloquentes inspexit; os aperivit sed cito recluserat.

source: Trier, Quartier de la Cathedrale Commemorative.
target: Trier, regio Cathedralis Commemorativa.

source: Jenna was curled up on the sofa, engrossed in the novels she had just bought, all with elements of Witches.
target: Jenna in sofa convoluta erat, novellis, quos nuper emit, ardenter legens, quorum omnia elementa magarum continebantur.

source: Suddenly, Rabbit Chasel appeared in front of her and handed her a letter.
target: Subito, Lepus Chasel coram ea apparuit et ei epistolam tradidit.

source: Observing the bizarre yet adorable rabbit-shaped creature, Jenna opened the letter and scanned its contents before asking earnestly, “Do you wish to select your payment, or shall I choose a random book for you?”
target: Observans creaturam miram sed venustam, forma leporum similem, Jenna epistolam aperuit atque eius contenta perscrutata est, antequam sincere interrogaret: “Velisne mercedem tuam eligere, aut an ego tibi librum fortuito eligo?”

source: “Lumian Lee has already settled the payment on your behalf,” Rabbit Chasel said in a deep yet sincere voice.
target: “Lumian Lee pro te iam solutionem fecerat,” Lepus Chasel voce profunda sed sincera dixerat.

source: Witch Jenna suddenly felt a sense of foreboding.
target: Maga Jenna subito maleficum augurium sensit.

source: “What has he paid?”
target: “Quid solvit?”

source: “He imparted shooting-related knowledge to me and guided me through the initial stage of my practice,” Rabbit Chasel raised the special revolver in his hand, briefly aimed it at the door behind Jenna, and then swiftly lowered it.
target: “Ipse mihi scientiam de iaculandi artem tradidit atque per initium exercitationis meae me duxit,” Lepus Chasel revolverum speciale in manu attulit, breviter ad ianuam post Jennam intendit, deinde celeriter deiecit.

source: W&— Monsieur Lumian Lee, have you considered the consequences of what you’ve done? Jenna chided, feeling a mix of irritation and amusement.
target: “Domine Lumian Lee, num consequentias factorum tuorum consideraveris?” Jenna increpavit, iracundia et hilaritate mixta sensit.

source: However, the deed was done, and she was powerless to reverse it.
target: Attamen, factum est, et illa id revocare non potuit.

source: As these thoughts raced through her mind, Jenna’s lips curved into a sweet smile.
target: Dum hae cogitationes per mentem eius volitabant, labra Jenna in dulci risu incurvata sunt.

source: “The next payment will be for a genuine underarm holster. And after that, custom-made bullets with special effects. How does that sound?”
target: “Proxima solutio erit pro vero receptaculo subbrachiali; et postea, globuli conscripti ad modum peculiarem cum effectibus specialibus. Quid hoc tibi videtur?”

source: Behind his glass glasses, Rabbit Chasel’s eyes sparkled.
target: Sub vitreis speculis, oculi Leporis Chasel micabant.

source: “Alright!”
target: “Bene!”

source: In Tizamo Town, night had already fallen, and darkness shrouded the area.
target: In oppido Tizamo, nox iam ceciderat, et tenebrae totam regionem tegebant.

source: Lumian stood in Hisoka’s house, glancing at the stern vice‑captain of the Port Pylos patrol team, Reaza, and the local patrol team leader, Maslow, whose face was adorned with white paint.
target: Lumian in domo Hisoka stabat, intuitus ad severum vice‑ducem turmae vigili Porti Pylos, Reaza, atque ad ducem vigiliarum localium, Maslow, cuius facies albo picta erat.

source: As though instructing Lugano, he said, “Watch out for any accidents.”
target: Velut monens Lugano, dixit: “Cave ne quid infortunium eveniat.”

source: This time, he spoke in Dutanese.
target: Hoc tempore in lingua Dutanica locutus est.

source: “Alright.”
target: “Recte.”

source: It wasn’t the first time Maslow had accompanied Louis Berry, the great adventurer, and he was already accustomed to his style.
target: Non primum Maslow comitabatur Louis Berry, magno adventatore, et iam eius consuetudine erat.

source: Dressed in a sleek formal suit, Reaza remained silent, signaling that there was no issue.
target: Indutus in habitum formalis nitidum, Reaza silens mansit, signum ferens nullam quaestionem exsistere.

source: Lumian retrieved the brown Mystery Prying Glasses from his Traveler’s Bag.
target: Lumian ex sacco viatoris specula inquisitiva et mystica brunnea extraxit.

source: Tonight, his first task was to use this magical item to observe Hisoka’s house from various angles, hoping to unveil the source of its abnormality.
target: Hac nocte, primum opus eius fuit hoc instrumento magico uti, ut domum Hisoka ex variis angulis observaret, sperans fontem eius anomaliae detegere.

source: After confirming his condition and preparations, Lumian placed the brown gold‑rimmed glasses on the bridge of his nose.
target: Postquam condicionem suam et praeparationes confirmavit, Lumian specula brunnea, margine aureo ornata, in ponte nasi sui posuit.

source: A familiar wave of dizziness washed over Lumian, as if his surroundings had been disrupted and reassembled.
target: Fluctus notus vertiginis Lumian oppresserat, quasi circumiecta eius turbata atque redeversa essent.

source: He witnessed poisonous insects crawling in the “sky,” two walls that seemed to dance in circles, and an underground water puddle deep in the soil that appeared to absorb all light..
target: Vidit insecta venenosa in “caelo” reptantia, duas parietes quae in circulis saltare videbantur, atque lacunam subterraneam aquosam in profundo solo, quae omnem lucem absorbere videbatur.
